programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: We reflect on the life and career of Nolberto Solano, one of South America's football legends. From his early days in Peru to his pivotal role in the Premier League, we explore his journey, triumphs, and challenges. Featuring exclusive interviews and rare footage, we capture the essence of a player who transcended borders and inspired generations.

programme.title: MATCH HIGHLIGHTS 24/25 MW26 Newcastle United v Nottingham Forest

programme.title: PL MOMENTS
programme.desc: Premier League legend Alan Shearer relives the ten biggest moments of his iconic career - from title glory with Blackburn to record-breaking goals at Newcastle. With insight, passion and a few surprises, PL Moments offers a personal look at the journey of the league's all-time top scorer.

programme.title: PL REWIND
programme.desc: A true Premier League icon, Alan Shearer recalls his career at his hometown club Newcastle United. The journey began with a world record transfer in 1996, and culminated with him setting both club and Premier League goalscoring records - achievements that have stood the test of time.

programme.title: Qualifying - Germany GP - Moto GP - 2025
programme.desc: Sachsenring, the shortest track on the MotoGP calendar at just 3.67 km, hosts a technical and thrilling qualifying session. The layout — dominated by 10 left-hand corners — demands total control and precision. Riders push the limits to secure pole position, where a good grid slot is vital. In 2024, Ducati locked out the front row. Can Marc Márquez reclaim his magic at the circuit where he holds a record 11 wins?

programme.title: Sprint Race - Germany GP - Moto GP - 2025
programme.desc: The sprint format — 15 laps, no pit stops, and half points — continues to deliver drama every Saturday. In 2024, Jorge Martín stole the show with a lights-to-flag victory, shaking up the championship standings. The Sachsenring’s tight turns and high tire wear make this sprint a pure test of balance between aggression and control. One mistake can ruin a weekend — but one bold move could define it.

programme.title: Main Race - Germany GP - Moto GP - 2025
programme.desc: Thirty laps around Sachsenring await MotoGP’s best in the 2025 German Grand Prix. The main race challenges every rider with extreme cornering loads and minimal rest. Last year, Pecco Bagnaia led Ducati to a dominant double podium. The race is crucial in the title race as we enter mid-season, with Yamaha and KTM both hungry to stop the red machine's reign. Expect bold overtakes, tight gaps, and no room for error.

programme.title: Qualifying - Germany Round - Moto 3 - 2025
programme.desc: Moto3 qualifying at Sachsenring is a thriller. Light bikes, teen drivers, and slipstream games make for chaos and courage. In 2024, David Alonso stunned the field with a last-minute flyer from deep in the field. Track position is critical — Sachsenring’s short lap punishes traffic, and a clear run is gold. Watch for tactics in the final minutes as the riders queue for the perfect tow.

programme.title: Qualifying - Germany Round - Moto 2 - 2025
programme.desc: Intermediate class riders push their Triumph 765cc-powered machines to the edge at Sachsenring, seeking a clean lap and pole glory. In 2024, Jake Dixon edged out Arón Canet by just 0.034 seconds. Track temperature and traffic make every attempt critical. A strong qualifying position often correlates to race success — and Moto2 margins are the slimmest in racing.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Liverpool English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Manchester United have won just one of their last 12 Premier League meetings with Liverpool, beating them 2-1 at Old Trafford in their third game of the 2022-23 campaign. Liverpool have lost just one of their last six Premier League away games against Manchester United, while only Manchester City have won away at Old Trafford more often than the Reds in the competition’s history.

programme.title: Everton vs Liverpool - English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Everton won 2-0 in their last Premier League game against Liverpool in April 2024, last winning consecutive league Merseyside derbies in the 1984-85 campaign. Liverpool’s 2-0 loss in this exact fixture last season ended a 12-game unbeaten away run in the Premier League against Everton. They’ve not lost consecutive visits to Goodison Park since a run of three between 1992 and 1994.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Crystal Palace- English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Man City have lost just one of their last 12 Premier League games against Crystal Palace, going down 2-0 at home in October 2021. Having lost each of their first six Premier League visits to the Etihad Stadium, Crystal Palace have lost just two of their last six away to Man City in the competition.

programme.title: Finale Dames. Amanda Anisimova / Iga Swiatek
programme.desc: Make way for the grand finale of Wimbledon between the American Amanda Anisimova and the Polish Iga Swiatek. Surprising Sabalenka in the semi-finals (6-4, 4-6, 6-4), Anisimova, 23, competes his very first Grand Chelem final. Mentally solid, she had to fight against Galfi and Noskova, but knew how to seize her luck in a clear painting. It remains to be seen whether the American explosive will still have the energy to challenge the infernal regularity of Iga Swiatek. The world number 8 has left crumbs to its opponents, notably shipping Bencic in a half (6-2, 6-0). Already a quintuple winner in Grand Slam, the Polish is targeting a first coronation at Wimbledon to complete the loop. In full confidence and strong of his experience, Swiatek advances as a great favorite. Anisimova has dropped the world n ° 1, but it is the n ° 1 of the lawn moment that she finds today.

programme.title: Northampton Saints / Bordeaux-Bègles
programme.desc: A finalist for the first time in its history after having overlooked the Toulouse title holder (35-18), the Union Bordeaux-Bègles is preparing to challenge Northampton in the Champions Cup final, with the ambition to register its name at the top of European rugby. Led by a Damian Penaud back at 100 % and already author of 12 trials in the competition, a Lucu-Jalibert hinge in total master's degree, an elusive Louis Bielle-Biarrey on his wing and a Depoortere-Moefana duo as solid as complementary to the center, the UBB has serious arguments to write a golden page of its history. But opposite, the saints of Northampton do not come as victims. Winners of the Leinster's courage in the semi-finals (37-34), the English bet on the vista of the young English prodigy, Henry Pollock, the end Smith's end at the opening and return of George Furbank to the rear to win a second European title. A final of fire in perspective at the Principality Stadium of Cardiff.

programme.title: Finale Dames. Amanda Anisimova / Iga Swiatek
programme.desc: Make way for the grand finale of Wimbledon between the American Amanda Anisimova and the Polish Iga Swiatek. Surprising Sabalenka in the semi-finals (6-4, 4-6, 6-4), Anisimova, 23, competes his very first Grand Chelem final. Mentally solid, she had to fight against Galfi and Noskova, but knew how to seize her luck in a clear painting. It remains to be seen whether the American explosive will still have the energy to challenge the infernal regularity of Iga Swiatek. The world number 8 has left crumbs to its opponents, notably shipping Bencic in a half (6-2, 6-0). Already a quintuple winner in Grand Slam, the Polish is targeting a first coronation at Wimbledon to complete the loop. In full confidence and strong of his experience, Swiatek advances as a great favorite. Anisimova has dropped the world n ° 1, but it is the n ° 1 of the lawn moment that she finds today.

programme.title: Gentlemen's final - Jannik Sinner - Carlos Alcaraz
programme.desc: A month after their epic final in Roland-Garros, Jannik Sinner and Carlos Alcaraz are doing this: the two masters of the ATP circuit meet in the Wimbledon final to write a new page of their rivalry. Winner in Paris after a crazy comeback, Alcaraz aims for a historic hat -trick in London (2023, 2024, 2025). Faced with him, Sinner dreams of a first coronation on lawn, which would allow him to conquer a third different major, at only 23 years old. It will be their 13th duel. The Spaniard leads 8-4, remains on five consecutive victories and has not been beaten by the Italian since October 2023. But their only confrontation on grass, already in Wimbledon, had turned to the advantage of Sinner in 2022. Alcaraz aims for continuity, sinner. Between two wonders already in legend, the final promises a summit up to their meteoric ascent.

programme.title: Tours / Poitiers
programme.desc: Last act, last breath: the TVB is about to live an evening with a history on Saturday in Grenon, against Poitiers. Winner at the first leg (3-1), Tours has a golden opportunity to win a 10th title of champion of France, which would propel him at the height of AS Cannes at the top of the hexagonal volleyball. But a derby does not obey any logic. Poitiers, heckled but far from being killed, knows that it would be a victory, four daring sets, to write his own legend. The feat of Nantes last year, who came to impose themselves in the gold set, feeds their hopes. The Alterna will count on Nik Mujanovic, in search of a last shine under the pepper colors before joining the TVB this summer. At the end of the road: Europe and the Champions League. But for Tours, it is also the culmination of a forged season in the fight. From Luca Ramon to Ryan Sclater, all want to write the perfect epilogue under the leadership of Marcelo Fronckowiak and engrave their name in the marble of Grenon.

Despite a sawtooth season, the Rhodanians seem ready to strike a big blow to Cardiff. But Bath arrives launched. With the duo Charlie Ewels - Quinn Roux in spearhead of the pack, the Vista of Captain Ben Spencer at the melee and the magic of Finn Russell at the opening, the English intend to conclude their formidable season with a continental title. Duel of styles in sight, with a Euro trophy ...

programme.title: Finale Dames. Amanda Anisimova / Iga Swiatek
programme.desc: Make way for the grand finale of Wimbledon between the American Amanda Anisimova and the Polish Iga Swiatek. Surprising Sabalenka in the semi-finals (6-4, 4-6, 6-4), Anisimova, 23, competes his very first Grand Chelem final. Mentally solid, she had to fight against Galfi and Noskova, but knew how to seize her luck in a clear painting. It remains to be seen whether the American explosive will still have the energy to challenge the infernal regularity of Iga Swiatek. The world number 8 has left crumbs to its opponents, notably shipping Bencic in a half (6-2, 6-0). Already a quintuple winner in Grand Slam, the Polish is targeting a first coronation at Wimbledon to complete the loop. In full confidence and strong of his experience, Swiatek advances as a great favorite. Anisimova has dropped the world n ° 1, but it is the n ° 1 of the lawn moment that she finds today.
